Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>

Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>

    Bug 1926674 - Port bug 1710599: Switch from bz2 to xz for Thunderbird releases on https://ftp.mozilla.org/. r=rjl
    
    Port of https://hg.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/efdd71a3303c428ca69ad6bab5a0ba12edd6b23d
    This is just a find/replace from .tar.bz2 to .tar.xz.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D230359

diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_candidates.yml b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_candidates.yml
index 7bf0cee8f6d..1cf839aef77 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_candidates.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_candidates.yml
@@ -222,7 +222,7 @@ mapping:
             - win64-shippable
         destinations:
             - ${version}-candidates/build${build_number}/mar-tools
-    target.tar.bz2:
+    target.tar.xz:
         <<: *default
         description: "Main installer for Linux platforms"
         all_locales: true
@@ -231,9 +231,9 @@ mapping:
         only_for_platforms:
             - linux-shippable
             - linux64-shippable
-        pretty_name: thunderbird-${version}.tar.bz2
-        checksums_path: ${path_platform}/${locale}/thunderbird-${version}.tar.bz2
-    target.tar.bz2.asc:
+        pretty_name: thunderbird-${version}.tar.xz
+        checksums_path: ${path_platform}/${locale}/thunderbird-${version}.tar.xz
+    target.tar.xz.asc:
         <<: *default
         description: "Detached signature for the checksums file"
         all_locales: true
@@ -242,8 +242,8 @@ mapping:
         only_for_platforms:
             - linux-shippable
             - linux64-shippable
-        pretty_name: thunderbird-${version}.tar.bz2.asc
-        checksums_path: ${path_platform}/${locale}/thunderbird-${version}.tar.bz2.asc
+        pretty_name: thunderbird-${version}.tar.xz.asc
+        checksums_path: ${path_platform}/${locale}/thunderbird-${version}.tar.xz.asc
     target.pkg:
         <<: *default
         description: "Main package installer for Mac OS X platforms"
diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_nightly.yml b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_nightly.yml

                     - ${year}/${month}/${upload_date}-${branch}-l10n

+    target.tar.xz.asc:

             - linux-shippable

-        pretty_name: thunderbird-${version}.${locale}.${filename_platform}.tar.bz2.asc

diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
index 84c0999b30e..ef9beab7ab1 100755
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
@@ -47,8 +47,8 @@ rm -rf "$SOURCE_DEST" && mkdir -p "$SOURCE_DEST"
 rm -rf ~/.local/share/flatpak/
 
 # Download en-US linux64 (English, 64-bit Linux) Thunderbird binary
-$CURL -o "${WORKSPACE}/thunderbird.tar.bz2" \
-    "${CANDIDATES_DIR}/${VERSION}-candidates/build${BUILD_NUMBER}/linux-x86_64/en-US/thunderbird-${VERSION}.tar.bz2"
+$CURL -o "${WORKSPACE}/thunderbird.tar.xz" \
+    "${CANDIDATES_DIR}/${VERSION}-candidates/build${BUILD_NUMBER}/linux-x86_64/en-US/thunderbird-${VERSION}.tar.xz"
 
 # Fetch langpack extension for each locale
 mkdir -p "$DISTRIBUTION_DIR"
@@ -121,7 +121,7 @@ EOF
 # Install Thunderbird files into appdir
 appdir=build/files
 install -d "${appdir}/lib/"
-(cd "${appdir}/lib/" && tar jxf "${WORKSPACE}/thunderbird.tar.bz2")
+(cd "${appdir}/lib/" && tar jxf "${WORKSPACE}/thunderbird.tar.xz")
 install -D -m644 -t "${appdir}/share/appdata" org.mozilla.Thunderbird.appdata.xml
 install -D -m644 -t "${appdir}/share/applications" org.mozilla.Thunderbird.desktop
 for size in 16 32 48 64 128; do
diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-snap/repack.sh b/taskcluster/docker/tb-snap/repack.sh
index 91333d6f518..c845c2e122f 100755
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-snap/repack.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-snap/repack.sh
@@ -32,9 +32,9 @@ mkdir -p "$DISTRIBUTION_DIR"
 mkdir -p "$DISTRIBUTION_DIR/extensions"
 
 # Download and extract en-US linux64 binary
-$CURL -o "${WORKSPACE}/${PRODUCT}.tar.bz2" \
-    "${CANDIDATES_DIR}/${VERSION}-candidates/build${BUILD_NUMBER}/linux-x86_64/en-US/${PRODUCT}-${VERSION}.tar.bz2"
-tar -C "$SOURCE_DEST" -xf "${WORKSPACE}/${PRODUCT}.tar.bz2" --strip-components=1
+$CURL -o "${WORKSPACE}/${PRODUCT}.tar.xz" \
+    "${CANDIDATES_DIR}/${VERSION}-candidates/build${BUILD_NUMBER}/linux-x86_64/en-US/${PRODUCT}-${VERSION}.tar.xz"
+tar -C "$SOURCE_DEST" -xf "${WORKSPACE}/${PRODUCT}.tar.xz" --strip-components=1
 
 # Download L10N XPIs (excluding ja-JP-mac)
 readarray -t locales < <(echo "$PKG_LOCALES" | jq -r '.[]')
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml
index f9e59110596..08c831c590d 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml
@@ -89,7 +89,7 @@ tasks:
         env:
             by-build-platform:
                 linux.*:    # linux64 and 32 get same treatment here
-                    EN_US_PACKAGE_NAME: target.tar.bz2
+                    EN_US_PACKAGE_NAME: target.tar.xz

                         artifact-reference: <build/{artifact_prefix}>

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-flatpak-repackage/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-flatpak-repackage/kind.yml
index 110c27589b8..3e1ad9e1e6f 100644

     run-on-projects: []  # to make sure this never runs as part of CI
     run-on-releases: [beta, release, esr128]
     shipping-phase: promote
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-snap-repackage/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-snap-repackage/kind.yml

     shipping-phase: promote
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/shippable-l10n/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/shippable-l10n/kind.yml
index 7ed450eb92f..c31f5e91ee6 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/shippable-l10n/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/shippable-l10n/kind.yml
@@ -98,7 +98,7 @@ tasks:
         env:
             by-build-platform:
                 linux.*:   # linux64 and 32 get same treatment here
-                    EN_US_PACKAGE_NAME: target.tar.bz2
+                    EN_US_PACKAGE_NAME: target.tar.xz
                     EN_US_BINARY_URL:
                         artifact-reference: <build-signing/{artifact_prefix}>
                 macosx64.*:
